passage.text: There have been numerous well-documented extinctions of indigenous species caused by the introduction of nonindigenous predators and pathogens. However, surprisingly few extinctions of indigenous species can be attributed to competition from introduced species. For example, during the past 400 years, 4,000 plant species have been introduced into North America, and these nonindigenous plants currently account for nearly 20 percent of North America's plant species. Yet no evidence exists that any indigenous North American plant species became extinct as a result of competition fromintroduced plant species. The scarcity of documented extinctions caused by competition from new species could mean that such extinctions take longer to occur than scientists initially believed or, alternatively, that extinctions are rarely caused by competition from nonindigenous species.

translation.passage_zh: 已有许多记录翔实的案例表明，引入非本土捕食者和病原体会造成原生物种灭绝。然而，令人惊讶的是，极少有原生物种灭绝可归因于与引入物种的竞争。例如，过去四百年中有四千种植物被引入北美，这些非本土植物目前约占北美植物物种的百分之二十；但没有证据表明任何北美原生植物物种因同引入植物竞争而灭绝。由新物种竞争造成的、有记录的灭绝案例之所以稀少，可能意味着此类灭绝发生所需时间比科学家原先认为的更长；另一种可能是，非本土物种的竞争很少导致灭绝。

passage.text: Some archaeologists speculate that the Americas might have been initially colonized between 40,000 and 25,000 years ago. However, to support this theory it is necessary to explain the absence of generally accepted habitation sites for that time interval in what is now the United States. Australia, which has a smaller land area than the United States, has many such sites, supporting the generally accepted claim that the continent was colonized by humans at least 40,000 years ago. Australia is less densely populated (resulting in lower chances of discovering sites) and with its overall greater aridity would have presented conditions less favorable for hunter-gatherer occupation. Proportionally, at least as much land area has been lost from the coastal regions of Australia because of postglacial sea-level rise as in the United States, so any coastal archaeological record in Australia should have been depleted about as much as a coastal record in the United States. Since there are so many resource-rich rivers leading inlandfrom the United States coastline, it seems implausible that a growing population of humans would have confined itself to coasts for thousands of years. If inhabitants were present 25,000 years ago, the chances of their appearing in the archaeological record would seem to be greater than for Australia.

answer.rationale_zh: 文章先呈现“美洲可能在四万至二万五千年前已被殖民”的推测，继而用澳大利亚的比较和多项理由说明美国完全没有遗址难以解释，构成对该主张的反驳。

translation.passage_zh: 一些考古学家推测，美洲最初可能在距今四万至二万五千年前之间就已有人定居。然而，要支持这一理论，就必须解释为什么在现今美国境内没有被普遍认可的、属于该时段的居住遗址。面积小于美国的澳大利亚却有许多这样的遗址，这支持了人类至少在四万年前已殖民澳大利亚这一被普遍接受的观点。澳大利亚人口密度更低（因而发现遗址的机会也更低），而且整体更干旱，本应更不利于狩猎采集者居住。按比例计算，冰期后海平面上升使澳大利亚沿海丧失的陆地面积至少与美国一样多，因此澳大利亚的沿海考古记录本应同美国的沿海记录一样严重受损。美国海岸线有许多通往内陆、资源丰富的河流，因此一个不断增长的人口会数千年只局限在海岸地区似乎不合情理。若二万五千年前已有居民，他们出现在考古记录中的机会应当大于澳大利亚。

passage.text: Some archaeologists speculate that the Americas might have been initially colonized between 40,000 and 25,000 years ago. However, to support this theory it is necessary to explain the absence of generally accepted habitation sites for that time interval in what is now the United States. Australia, which has a smaller land area than the United States, has many such sites, supporting the generally accepted claim that the continent was colonized by humans at least 40,000 years ago. Australia is less densely populated (resulting in lower chances of discovering sites) and with its overall greater aridity would have presented conditions less favorable for hunter-gatherer occupation. Proportionally, at least as much land area has been lost from the coastal regions of Australia because of postglacial sea-level rise as in the United States, so any coastal archaeological record in Australia should have been depleted about as much as a coastal record in the United States. Since there are so many resource-rich rivers leading inlandfrom the United States coastline, it seems implausible that a growing population of humans would have confined itself to coasts for thousands of years. If inhabitants were present 25,000 years ago, the chances of their appearing in the archaeological record would seem to be greater than for Australia.

passage.text: Historical demographers have generally agreedon two interrelated features of the urban populations in early-modern Germany. First, in accordance with the law of natural decrease, extremely high mortality rates in cities (urban areas with more than10,000 inhabitants) meant that their populations could not be sustained by reproduction alone. Population density, inadequate sanitary conditions, andpoor housing made cities too vulnerable to disease and death. Second, when city populations did increase, it was as a result of in- migration sufficient to overcome the population losses caused by the high mortality. But because the parish registers of urban communities with fewer than 10,000 inhabitants show that the annual number of births usually equaled or exceeded that of deaths, historical demographers assume that the law of natural decrease did not apply to small towns.

translation.passage_zh: 历史人口学家一般同意早期现代德国城市人口具有两个彼此相关的特征。第一，依照自然减少规律，城市（人口超过一万的城市）极高的死亡率意味着其人口不能只靠生育维持。人口密度、卫生条件不足和住房恶劣使城市极易遭受疾病和死亡。第二，当城市人口增加时，是因为迁入人口足以抵消高死亡率造成的人口损失。但人口少于一万的城市社区的教区登记显示，年度出生数通常等于或超过死亡数；因此，历史人口学家认为，自然减少规律不适用于小城镇。

passage.text: It's hard to envision jazz flourishing without Thomas Edison's roughly contemporaneous invention of sound recording technology, which enabled the preservation and dissemination of the genre's hallmark musical improvisations for the first time in history. But the same technology also significantly altered jazz's evolution. Before the rise of jazz, African American composers worked extensively with more complex forms. Most of Scott Joplin's ragtime pieces included four sections, each with a distinctive melody and chords, and many early jazz musicians continued in this vein. But early recordings, which limited songs to three minutes, could rarely accommodate such structures and still leave time for improvised solos. With a few exceptions, such as Duke Ellington, most jazz musicians embraced simpler tunes once they began recording their work.

answer.label: B
answer.text: suggest a way in which early recording technology influenced the development of jazz
answer.rationale_zh: 高亮句指出三分钟录音时长限制了复杂多段结构和即兴独奏的共存，直接说明录音技术怎样促使爵士乐转向更简单的曲调。

passage.text: While marine hermit crabs are well known for being omnivorous filter feeders, less is known about the role they may play as active carrion scavengers in intertidal ecosystems. Prior studies have revealed that intertidal hermit crabs can be attracted to chemical cues from gastropods (snails) killed by predators. Yet their attraction is usually assumed to be driven primarily by the availability of new shells for shelters rather than by food. Researchers conducted field experiments to assess hermit crabs' potential role as generalist carrion scavengers on the California coast, examining their speed of attraction and the size of the aggregations they formed in response to chemical cues from freshly smashed gastropods and mussels, both of which indicated available carrion. Compared to all other marine species, hermit crabs were the fastest to arrive at the provisioning sites. Hermit crabs also dominated the provisioning sites, accumulating in the largest numbers, with aggregations of up to 20 individuals, which outcompeted all other scavengers for carrion. Notably, hermit crabs arrived equally quickly for both smashed gastropod and mussel, even though the latter does not offer suitable shells for hermit crabs and even though the former only yields shell-related chemical cues over time frames longer than the experiments. These results thus suggest that shell availability is not the only, or even the primary, reason marine intertidal hermit crabs aggregate at carrion sites; they also aggregate to forage, thereby playing an important role as active carrion scavengers in intertidal ecosystems.

translation.passage_zh: 海洋寄居蟹以杂食性的滤食者而闻名，但人们对它们在潮间带生态系统中充当主动食腐者的作用所知较少。早期研究发现，潮间带寄居蟹会受到被捕食者杀死的腹足类动物（蜗牛）释放出的化学信号吸引；但通常认为，这种吸引力主要来自可作庇护所的新贝壳，而非食物。研究人员在加利福尼亚海岸进行了野外实验，以评估寄居蟹作为广食性食腐者的潜在作用；他们考察寄居蟹对刚被砸碎的腹足类动物和贻贝（两者都表示有可食用腐肉）的化学信号作出反应时，到达的速度和形成聚集群的大小。与其他所有海洋物种相比，寄居蟹最快到达投放地点。寄居蟹还以最大的数量占据这些地点，聚集群最多可达二十只，并在争夺腐肉时胜过所有其他清道夫。值得注意的是，寄居蟹对砸碎的腹足类动物和贻贝到达得同样快，尽管后者不能提供适合寄居蟹的贝壳，且前者只有在比实验更长的时间尺度上才会产生与贝壳有关的化学信号。因此，这些结果表明，贝壳的可获得性不是、甚至可能不是主要的、海洋潮间带寄居蟹聚集在腐肉地点的原因；它们也会聚集来觅食，从而在潮间带生态系统中作为主动食腐者发挥重要作用。

passage.text: The scientific method is not radically different from the rational attitude in everyday life or in other domains of human knowledge. Historians, detectives, and plumbers—indeed, all human beings—use the same basic methods of induction, deduction, and assessment of evidence as do physicists or biochemists. Modern science tries to carry out these operations in a more careful and systematic way by using controls and statistical tests, insisting on replication, and so forth. Moreover, scientific measurements are often much more precise than everyday observations; they allow us to discover hitherto unknown phenomena, and they often lead to discoveries that conflict with "common sense." But the conflict is at the level of conclusions, not the basic approach.

passage.text: The first phase of English literature can be described as ending with the Protestant Reformation, which radically changed English culture. Though the literature produced before the Reformation varied markedly, a consistency is often apparent: it was grounded in the Latin Christianity that dominated Western Europe from the early Middle Ages to the sixteenth century. The Christian Church, however, had taken form in the midst of the powerful pagan cultures of ancient Greece and Rome, and the later Roman and Irish missionaries to England planted the Church in the midst of still another pagan culture, that of the ancient Germanic peoples who inhabited England. Oddly enough, the new religion scorned neither the literary tradition of Greco-Roman paganism nor that of Germanic paganism. Aldhelm, the first English poet who wrote in Latin, and Caedmon, the first to use English, were contemporaries, and each sang the praises of the Christian God in an artistic medium inherited from paganism.

options.label: E
options.text: Translation of classical literature into an artistic medium inherited from Germanic paganism

answer.label: C
answer.text: Acceptance of the literary traditions of both
answer.rationale_zh: 文章直接说新宗教“既没有轻视”希腊—罗马异教的文学传统，也没有轻视日耳曼异教的文学传统，故选C。

translation.passage_zh: 英国文学的第一阶段可被描述为以新教改革为终点，后者深刻改变了英国文化。虽然改革前创作的文学差异很大，仍常可看到一种一致性：它以从中世纪早期至十六世纪主宰西欧的拉丁基督教为根基。然而，基督教会是在古希腊和罗马强大的异教文化中形成的；后来罗马和爱尔兰传教士把教会带到英格兰时，又将它植入当地古日耳曼人的另一种异教文化中。颇为奇特的是，这个新宗教既没有轻视希腊—罗马异教的文学传统，也没有轻视日耳曼异教的文学传统。第一位用拉丁文写作的英国诗人奥尔德海姆（Aldhelm）与第一位使用英语写作的凯德蒙（Caedmon）是同时代人；二人都借用从异教传承而来的艺术媒介，歌颂基督教的上帝。

translation.passage_zh: 英国文学的第一阶段可被描述为以新教改革为终点，后者深刻改变了英国文化。虽然改革前创作的文学差异很大，仍常可看到一种一致性：它以从中世纪早期至十六世纪主宰西欧的拉丁基督教为根基。然而，基督教会是在古希腊和罗马强大的异教文化中形成的；后来罗马和爱尔兰传教士把教会带到英格兰时，又将它植入当地古日耳曼人的另一种异教文化中。颇为奇特的是，这个新宗教既没有轻视希腊—罗马异教的文学传统，也没有轻视日耳曼异教的文学传统。第一位用拉丁文写作的英国诗人奥尔德海姆（Aldhelm）与第一位使用英语写作的凯德蒙（Caedmon）是同时代人；二人都借用从异教传承而来的艺术媒介，歌颂基督教的上帝。

passage.text: An Irish newspaper editorial encouraging women to participate in the nonimportation movement launched in Ireland in 1779 appears consistent with a perception that the political use of the consumer boycott originated in North America and spread eastwards across the Atlantic to Ireland. This is a view that most historians have concurred with. For example, T. H. Breen argued that the consumer boycott was a "brilliantly original American invention." Breen did acknowledge that "a few isolated boycotts may have taken place in other countries." However, Mary O' Dowd argues that from the late seventeenth century, Irish political discourse advocated for the nonconsumption of imported goods and support for home manufactures by women in ways that were strikingly similar to those used later in North America.

passage.text: In his history of algebra, John Derbyshire asserts that when Descartes chose the letter x to represent the principal unknown, he did so for the printer's convenience, because x is used less often in French than y or z. In fact, according to cryptography texts, x is used more often than y in French. Derbyshire's source for his assertion is Classic Math, whose author, Art Johnson, gives no footnote for the claim but who may have misunderstood a conjecture made in 1905—almost 300 years after Descartes—by Gustav Eneström and mentioned in a book included in Johnson's bibliography. Eneström supposed that x was chosen because it occurs more often than y and z, and printers therefore would have had more s available.

records.questionText: It can be inferred that the author of the passage would agree with which of the following statements about the relationship between Eneström's conjecture and Derbyshire? Derbyshire's assertion derives ultimately from a

options.label: B
options.text: Derbyshire's bibliography suggests that he was familiar with Eneström's conjecture.

options.label: C
options.text: Derbyshire wrote his work almost 300 years after Eneström's conjecture was published.

texts: Derbyshire's assertion derives ultimately from a misunderstanding of Eneström's conjecture.
answer.rationale_zh: 文中说德比郡引用约翰逊的《经典数学》，而约翰逊可能误解了埃内斯特伦的猜想，故 A 正确。埃内斯特伦的猜想出现在约翰逊而非德比郡的书目中，且近 300 年是相对笛卡尔的时间，B、C 均错误。

translation.passage_zh: 约翰·德比郡在其代数史中断言，笛卡尔选择字母 x 表示主要未知数，是为了方便印刷商，因为在法语中 x 的使用频率低于 y 或 z。事实上，据密码学文献记载，x 在法语中的使用频率高于 y。德比郡这一断言的来源是《经典数学》；其作者阿特·约翰逊没有给该主张加脚注，却可能误解了古斯塔夫·埃内斯特伦在 1905 年（笛卡尔之后近 300 年）提出的一个猜想。该猜想被提及于约翰逊参考书目中的一本书。埃内斯特伦认为，x 被选中是因为它出现得比 y 和 z 更频繁，印刷商因此会有更多的 x 字模可用。
translation.question_zh: 可以推断，文章作者会同意下列哪项关于埃内斯特伦的猜想与德比郡之间关系的表述？

options_zh.label: A
options_zh.text_zh: 德比郡的断言最终源于对埃内斯特伦猜想的误解。

options_zh.label: B
options_zh.text_zh: 德比郡的参考书目表明他熟悉埃内斯特伦的猜想。

options_zh.label: C
options_zh.text_zh: 德比郡在埃内斯特伦的猜想发表近 300 年后才写作。

answer.rationale_zh: 高亮文本强调Eneström的说法距离笛卡尔近三百年，结合其被称为“conjecture（猜想）”，凸显该解释是后来的推测，而非当时的确证，故选B。

translation.passage_zh: 在其代数史中，John Derbyshire断言，笛卡尔选择字母 x 表示主要未知数，是为了方便印刷商，因为在法语中 x 的使用频率低于 y 或 z。事实上，据密码学教材，法语中 x 的使用频率高于 y。Derbyshire的这一断言来自《Classic Math》；其作者Art Johnson没有给该说法注脚，但他可能误解了Gustav Eneström在1905年提出、并在Johnson参考书目所列的一本书中提及的一个猜想——这已是【高亮文本：笛卡尔之后近三百年】。Eneström推测，x 之所以被选中，是因为它比 y 和 z 出现得更频繁，因而印刷商会有更多 x 字模可用。

This image suggested specifically that the colonial commercial system was irrationally organized, choked Spain's economic progress, and generated unwarranted monopoly rents [profits], all for the benefit of the privileged traders of the merchant guilds. translation.passage_zh: 在近三个世纪的大部分时间里，主宰西班牙帝国远距离贸易的大商人，历来被历史学家描绘成一个享有特权的群体：他们动用政治和金融影响力保护自身利益，并从事缺乏竞争的经济行为，这在很大程度上损害了西班牙及其殖民地。这种形象具体暗示，殖民地商业体系组织得不合理，阻碍了西班牙经济进步，并制造了不正当的垄断租金（利润），一切只为商人行会中享有特权的贸易者谋利。这些结论没有一个完全错误，但它们大体未能理解这些贸易者所处环境的不可预测性。历史学家没有充分思考海洋贸易中的风险作用，因而常把大商人及其商业做法描绘得过于单一。面对信息匮乏、极大不确定性和长期存在的风险，远距离贸易者采取防御性策略，并接受降低风险的制度。规避风险并不意味着西班牙商人缺乏企业家精神，也不意味着他们是历史学家有时所暗示的前资本主义食利者。恰恰相反，任何商人若不持续预见风险、积极采取措施避免灾难，就无法在高风险的大西洋世界贸易中经营。

answer.rationale_zh: 作者说历史学家的结论“没有一项是完全错误的”，只批评其忽略了海洋贸易中的风险、刻画过于单一。因此双方都会承认商人曾用影响力保护利益、从事过某些非竞争性做法，且这些行为在一定程度上抑制了西班牙经济进步。

translation.passage_zh: 在西班牙帝国中主导长途贸易近三百年的大商人，历来被历史学家描绘为一个享有特权的群体：他们运用政治和金融影响力保护自身利益，同时从事非竞争性的经济做法，主要损害了西班牙及其殖民地。该形象具体意味着，殖民地商业体系组织得不合理，扼杀了西班牙的经济进步，并产生了无根据的垄断利润，一切都服务于商人行会中享有特权的商人。没有一项这样的结论是完全错误的，但它们很大程度上没有理解这些商人从事贸易时所处的不可预测环境。由于没有充分思考海洋商业中风险的作用，历史学家往往把大商人及其商业实践描绘得过于单一。长途商人面对信息匮乏、巨大的不确定性和无处不在的风险，采取防御策略并接受降低风险的制度。可是，规避风险既不意味着西班牙商人缺乏企业家精神，也不意味着他们就是历史学家有时暗示的前资本主义食利者。相反，没有任何商人能在高风险的大西洋世界贸易中经营，却不持续预判并积极采取措施避免灾难。

records.questionText: Subsistence activities are often(i). by people in industrialized societies who see them as (ii). In point of fact, however, these activities are not mere holdovers from the past; rather, they are essential elements of cultural identity in some societies today, such as those of arctic aboriginal people.

answer.rationale_zh: 后文用“实际上”否定把自给活动当作过去遗存的看法，因此工业化社会的人是在误解它们，把它们视作过时之物。
answer.coherence_zh: “误解—过时”与“并非过去遗存、而是文化身份”形成清晰转折。

translation.question_zh: 工业化社会的人往往会 (i) 自给性活动，把它们看作 (ii) 的。事实上，这些活动并非只是过去遗留下来的东西；相反，在今天的一些社会里，例如北极原住民社会，它们是文化身份不可或缺的组成部分。

records.questionText: The theater's stately production certainly does keep (i). and the high praise it has received for its (ii). could thus be called justified. But perhaps the performance goes too far in that direction. The (iii). story line that makes this one of Shakespeare's most wayward (and least performed) plays has been smoothed into a well-drilled parade of avowals and betrayals, plots and counterplots, deaths and resurrections.

During 1971–1990, food poisoning—primarily bacterial—affected 29 out of every 100,000 Japanese but only 3 out of every 100,000 Koreans, despite the countries'similar temperate climates. answer.rationale_zh: 该句列出比较两国肉类食谱得到的具体证据：韩国食谱更常使用至少一种香料、每份食谱所含香料更多，并且更常使用强抑菌香料。作者据此在下一句解释为何韩国食谱更可能抑制更多细菌，从而解释两国食物中毒率的差异。

translation.passage_zh: 尽管电力制冷已广泛可得，香料的抗微生物特性仍可能有用。1971 至 1990 年间，食物中毒——主要是细菌性食物中毒——在每十万名日本人中影响了 29 人，而在每十万名韩国人中只影响了 3 人，尽管两国都处于相似的温带气候。Lee 认为这种差异可能源于食物处理和制作上的文化差异，这一建议很可能是正确的。不过，此外，尽管日本的肉类食谱合计使用的香料种类更多，韩国食谱却更常要求至少使用一种香料、每份食谱所含香料更多，也更常要求使用强抑菌香料。因此，平均而言，一份韩国食谱最可能抑制的细菌比例明显高于一份日本食谱。

passage.text: The first phase of English literature can be described as ending with the Protestant Reformation, which radically changed English culture. Though the literature produced before the Reformation varied markedly, a consistency is often apparent: it was grounded in the Latin Christianity that dominated Western Europe from the early Middle Ages to the sixteenth century. The Christian Church, however, had taken form in the midst of the powerful pagan cultures of ancient Greece and Rome, and the later Roman and Irish missionaries to England planted the Church in the midst of still another pagan culture, that of the ancient Germanic peoples who inhabited England. Oddly enough, the new religion scorned neither the literary tradition of Greco-Roman paganism nor that of Germanic paganism. Aldhelm, the first English poet who wrote in Latin, and Caedmon, the first to use English, were contemporaries, and each sang the praises of the Christian God in an artistic medium inherited from paganism.

translation.passage_zh: 英国文学的第一阶段可被描述为以新教改革为终点，后者深刻改变了英国文化。虽然改革前创作的文学差异很大，仍常可看到一种一致性：它以从中世纪早期至十六世纪主宰西欧的拉丁基督教为根基。然而，基督教会是在古希腊和罗马强大的异教文化中形成的；后来罗马和爱尔兰传教士把教会带到英格兰时，又将它植入当地古日耳曼人的另一种异教文化中。颇为奇特的是，这个新宗教既没有轻视希腊—罗马异教的文学传统，也没有轻视日耳曼异教的文学传统。第一位用拉丁文写作的英国诗人奥尔德海姆（Aldhelm）与第一位使用英语写作的凯德蒙（Caedmon）是同时代人；二人都借用从异教传承而来的艺术媒介，歌颂基督教的上帝。

records.questionText: Pauline Kael's first movie review tore into Charlie Chaplin for taking up the mantle of comic artist rather than claiming his roots as slapstick clown. It might seem strange that a reviewer with such highbrow reading tastes as Kael had would attack upward-reaching film entertainers for their pretensions and champion films that were mainstream entertainments. Yet such a stance could itself be seen as (i)., as it (ii). a certain idea of true art from (iii). as if only literature should aspire to seriousness.

answer.rationale_zh: Kael 偏爱主流娱乐、却要求“真正艺术”只能属于严肃文学，这不是平等，而是维护高雅艺术边界的精英主义；她在防卫该观念免受大众文化侵入。
answer.coherence_zh: “精英主义—守护高雅艺术概念—抵制大众侵入”准确概括了这种立场。

translation.question_zh: Pauline Kael 的第一篇影评严厉批评 Charlie Chaplin：他披上了喜剧艺术家的外衣，而没有承认自己源自闹剧小丑。像 Kael 这样阅读品位高雅的评论家，攻击追求高雅的电影娱乐者之矫饰、却拥护主流娱乐电影，似乎很奇怪。然而，这种立场本身也可以被视为 (i) 的，因为它 (ii) 一种关于真正艺术的观念，使其免受 (iii) 的影响，仿佛只有文学才应追求严肃性。

passage.text: The United States Civil Rights movement, whichbegan in the 1950s and gained momentum in the 1960s and 1970s, owed a heavy debt to African American newspapers. This is not to suggest that the African American press caused the Civil Rights era. But its continual push from 1910 to 1950 for more African American rights, using a compelling form of advocacy journalism rather than the standard objective newspaper style, allowed those who in the 1950s began pushing nationally for equality to start at a far higher level than if the African American press had not existed. This point has largely been missed by many Americans, who seem to believe the Civil Rights era erupted from a standstill like a dormant geyser. But that is not how history occurs.

passage.text: It is fair to say that the discovery of chimpanzees using tools in the wild (van Lawick-Goodall 1968) was one of the most significant discoveries in field primatology and perhaps in animal behavior as a whole. This finding not only questioned the long-held assumption that using and manufacturing tools were the hallmark of humanity, but also reinvigorated the study of cognitive processes in apes. I say reinvigorated because tool use had been used by psychologists to investigate ape cognition long before its discovery in the wild. Both Köhler's and Yerkes' pioneering work in the 1920s on ape problem solving drew heavily on tool use. Yerkes saw tool use as an example of ideation, thinking in the absence of the actual stimuli, whereas Köhler saw it as an example of finding indirect solutions when the direct route was not possible. Köhler emphasized the insightful nature of several tool-use episodes, and he contrasted such a sudden mode of solution with the gradual trial-and-error learning that Thorndike had described with his puzzle boxes. Historically, this is the forerunner of a debate between association (i.e., apes respond to the presence of certain observable cues but without any real causal understanding) and reasoning that continues unresolved today.

translation.passage_zh: 可以说，在野外发现黑猩猩使用工具（van Lawick-Goodall，1968年）是灵长类田野研究中最重要的发现之一，也许在动物行为学整体中亦然。这一发现不但质疑了使用和制造工具是人类标志这一长期假设，也重新激发了对猿类认知过程的研究。我说“重新激发”，是因为早在野外发现之前，心理学家就已经用工具使用来研究猿类认知。Köhler和Yerkes在20世纪20年代对猿类问题解决的开创性研究都大量借助工具使用。Yerkes把工具使用看作观念作用的例子，即在实际刺激缺席时进行思考；Köhler则将其看作在直接途径不可行时寻找间接解决办法的例子。Köhler强调若干工具使用事件的顿悟性质，并把这种突然的解题方式与Thorndike用其谜箱所描述的渐进式试错学习作对比。从历史上看，这正是联想与推理之间争论的前身：联想指猿类会对某些可观察线索作出反应，却没有真正的因果理解；这一争论至今未决。

translation.passage_zh: 可以说，在野外发现黑猩猩使用工具（van Lawick-Goodall，1968年）是灵长类田野研究中最重要的发现之一，也许在动物行为学整体中亦然。这一发现不但质疑了使用和制造工具是人类标志这一长期假设，也重新激发了对猿类认知过程的研究。我说“重新激发”，是因为早在野外发现之前，心理学家就已经用工具使用来研究猿类认知。Köhler和Yerkes在20世纪20年代对猿类问题解决的开创性研究都大量借助工具使用。Yerkes把工具使用看作观念作用的例子，即在实际刺激缺席时进行思考；Köhler则将其看作在直接途径不可行时寻找间接解决办法的例子。Köhler强调若干工具使用事件的顿悟性质，并把这种突然的解题方式与Thorndike用其谜箱所描述的渐进式试错学习作对比。从历史上看，这正是联想与推理之间争论的前身：联想指猿类会对某些可观察线索作出反应，却没有真正的因果理解；这一争论至今未决。

passage.text: It is fair to say that the discovery of chimpanzees using tools in the wild (van Lawick-Goodall 1968) was one of the most significant discoveries in field primatology and perhaps in animal behavior as a whole. This finding not only questioned the long-held assumption that using and manufacturing tools were the hallmark of humanity, but also reinvigorated the study of cognitive processes in apes. I say reinvigorated because tool use had been used by psychologists to investigate ape cognition long before its discovery in the wild. Both Köhler's and Yerkes' pioneering work in the 1920s on ape problem solving drew heavily on tool use. Yerkes saw tool use as an example of ideation, thinking in the absence of the actual stimuli, whereas Köhler saw it as an example of finding indirect solutions when the direct route was not possible. Köhler emphasized the insightful nature of several tool-use episodes, and he contrasted such a sudden mode of solution with the gradual trial-and-error learning that Thorndike had described with his puzzle boxes. Historically, this is the forerunner of a debate between association (i.e., apes respond to the presence of certain observable cues but without any real causal understanding) and reasoning that continues unresolved today.

translation.passage_zh: 长期以来，评论界忽视Emily Brontë的诗歌；起初，这种忽视源于把维多利亚诗歌视为男性专属领域的观念。女性主义评论家挑战了这种理解，主要做法是抛弃那些要求作品具有特定题材或观点、因而低估不合其模式的女诗人的批评方法。但女性主义评论家自己关于维多利亚女诗歌的假设也可能排除Emily Brontë。Virginia Blain的维多利亚女诗人选集遗漏Brontë，这并非特例，而是有代表性的现象。Blain的目标是广泛收录“维多利亚女诗人最常采用的题材和诗歌处理方式”；然而，如Emily的姐姐Charlotte所说，Emily的诗歌“完全不像女性通常写的那类诗”。

passage.text: V To evaluate any given intellectual property policy, we must weigh the costs and benefits of awarding copyright protection. If an innovation would have been developed in the absence of such protection, then the benefits of the protection are nonexistent, and so, by the cost- benefit criterion, it is unwarranted. Such a situation arose in 1998, when the United States Congress extended the term of copyright from 50 years after an author's death to 70. Book buyers are harmed by this. A book's price is higher under copyright because the publisher continues to owe royalties to the author's heirs and does not compete with others printing the same book. Against that drawback, there is no countervailing benefit. Authors are hardly likely to find motivation in the prospect of earnings that will arrive more than 50 years after their death. Moreover, the extension was applied retroactively to existing copyrights—but authors do not need incentives to write books they have already written.

answer.rationale_zh: 作者先提出成本—收益标准，再用1998年版权期延长说明：既没有激励收益又有购书者成本时，政策不正当。因此重心是展示这一标准如何评估具体政策。

translation.passage_zh: 为了评估任何既定的知识产权政策，我们必须权衡授予版权保护的成本和收益。如果即使没有这种保护，某项创新也会被开发出来，那么保护带来的收益就不存在；依成本—收益准则，这种保护不正当。1998年就发生了这种情况：美国国会把版权期限从作者死亡后50年延长至70年。购书者因此受害。处于版权保护下的书更贵，因为出版商仍须向作者继承人支付版税，也不会与印刷同一本书的其他人竞争。与这一弊端相对，没有任何抵消性收益。作者几乎不可能因将在其死亡50多年后才到手的收入前景而受到激励。此外，这一延期还追溯适用于现有版权——但作者不需要激励去写他们已经写好的书。

passage.text: Astronomers who study planet formation once believed that comets—because they remain mostly in the distant Oort cloud, where temperatures are close to absolute zero—must be pristine relics of the material that formed the outer planets. The conceptual shift away from seeing comets as pristine relics began in the 1970s, when laboratory simulations revealed there was sufficient ultraviolet radiation reaching comets to darken their surfaces and there were sufficient cosmic rays to alter chemical bonds or even molecular structure near the surface. Nevertheless, astronomers still believed that when a comet approached the Sun—where they could study it—the Sun's intense heat would remove the corrupted surface layer, exposing the interior. About the same time, though, scientists realized comets might contain decaying radioactive isotopes that could have warmed cometary interiors to temperatures that caused the interiors to evolve.

options.text: It called into question an assumption that astronomers had made about comets.

options.label: E
options.text: It caused astronomers to revise their account of the composition of the outer planets.

answer.label: C
answer.text: It called into question an assumption that astronomers had made about comets.
answer.rationale_zh: 天文学家原先相信太阳会除去受损表层，从而露出仍保持原始状态的内部。放射性同位素能加热并使内部演化的发现，直接动摇了这一关于彗星内部的假设。

passage.text: That the narrator in George Eliot's novel Middlemarch (completed 1871) displays an astonishing breadth of knowledge may be partly explained by Eliot's reaction to a specializing division of labor that threatened an extinction of generalists. Some of Eliot's contemporaries attributed the nineteenth century's rapid specialization to an accelerating pace of knowledge production. But specialization, Eliot recognized, was not simply an effect of proliferating information. The notion that specialization was essential to an individual's credibility was also an ideological product of professionalization. Nineteenth-century professional organizations actively fostered public distrust of nonprofessionals, an effect, Eliot feared, that might pressure laypersons, confronted with unfamiliar fields, to resign their curiosity and abdicate moral authority, conceding decision-making to professionals. Eliot's narrator serves as her rejoinder: an ideal of intellectual expansiveness.

passage.text: As it was published in 1935, Mules and Men, Zora Neale Hurston's landmark collection of folktales, may not have been the book that its author first had in mind. In this anthropological study, Hurston describes in detail the people who tell the stories, often even inserting herself into the storytelling scene. Evidently, however, Hurston had prepared another version, a manuscript that was recently discovered and published after having been forgotten since 1929. This version differs from Mules and Men in that it simply records stories, with no descriptive or interpretive information. While we cannot know for certain why Hurston's original manuscript went unpublished during her lifetime, it may have been because publishers wanted something more than a transcription of tales. Contemporary novelist and critic John Edgar Wideman has described Black literature as the history of a writing that sought to "escape its frame," in other words, as the effort of Black writers to present the stories of Black people without having to have a mediating voice to explain the stories to a non-Black audience. In this, Hurston may have been ahead of her time.

translation.passage_zh: 1935 年出版的《骡子与人》是佐拉·尼尔·赫斯顿具有里程碑意义的民间故事集，但它未必是作者最初设想的那本书。在这部人类学研究中，赫斯顿详细描述讲故事的人，甚至常把自己写入讲故事的场景。然而显然，她还准备过另一个版本；这份手稿自 1929 年起被遗忘，最近才被发现并出版。该版本与《骡子与人》的不同之处在于，它只记录故事，没有描述性或阐释性信息。我们无法确知赫斯顿的原始手稿为何在她生前未出版，原因可能是出版商希望得到的不只是故事的转录。当代小说家兼批评家约翰·埃德加·怀德曼把黑人文学描述为一种试图“逃离其框架”的写作史；换言之，黑人作家努力呈现黑人的故事，而不必借助一个中介性的声音向非黑人读者解释这些故事。在这一点上，赫斯顿可能走在了时代前面。

passage.text: As it was published in 1935, Mules and Men, Zora Neale Hurston's landmark collection of folktales, may not have been the book that its author first had in mind. In this anthropological study, Hurston describes in detail the people who tell the stories, often even inserting herself into the storytelling scene. Evidently, however, Hurston had prepared another version, a manuscript that was recently discovered and published after having been forgotten since 1929. This version differs from Mules and Men in that it simply records stories, with no descriptive or interpretive information. While we cannot know for certain why Hurston's original manuscript went unpublished during her lifetime, it may have been because publishers wanted something more than a transcription of tales. Contemporary novelist and critic John Edgar Wideman has described Black literature as the history of a writing that sought to "escape its frame," in other words, as the effort of Black writers to present the stories of Black people without having to have a mediating voice to explain the stories to a non-Black audience. In this, Hurston may have been ahead of her time.

records.questionText: Replacement of the word "present" with which of the following results in the least change in meaning for the passage?

answer.label: C
answer.text: offer
answer.rationale_zh: 文中 present 是“呈现、提供给读者看”的意思：黑人作家把黑人的故事直接呈现出来。五个选项中 offer 最接近这种“呈现/提供”的含义；其余词更多指交付、捐赠、提议或正式提交，故选 C。

translation.passage_zh: 1935 年出版的《骡子与人》是佐拉·尼尔·赫斯顿具有里程碑意义的民间故事集，但它未必是作者最初设想的那本书。在这部人类学研究中，赫斯顿详细描述讲故事的人，甚至常把自己写入讲故事的场景。然而显然，她还准备过另一个版本；这份手稿自 1929 年起被遗忘，最近才被发现并出版。该版本与《骡子与人》的不同之处在于，它只记录故事，没有描述性或阐释性信息。我们无法确知赫斯顿的原始手稿为何在她生前未出版，原因可能是出版商希望得到的不只是故事的转录。当代小说家兼批评家约翰·埃德加·怀德曼把黑人文学描述为一种试图“逃离其框架”的写作史；换言之，黑人作家努力呈现黑人的故事，而不必借助一个中介性的声音向非黑人读者解释这些故事。在这一点上，赫斯顿可能走在了时代前面。

passage.text: From a biological perspective, culture may be broadly defined as shared variation in behavior that is generated and maintained by social learning—through imitation or teaching, for example. Social learning in animals is often difficult to demonstrate directly. But the presence of culture can be established by observation and deduction: when behavioral differences exist that cannot be accounted for by genetic or environmental factors, cultural transmission must be occurring. Critics respond that it is often difficult to rule out hypotheses that genes or learned individual responses to differing environments are responsible for behavioral patterns. Often implicit in this argument is the notion that social learning, considered a more complex and more cognitively demanding phenomenon than individual learning, should be invoked only as an explanation of last resort.

passage.text: Questions 7 through 9 are based on the following passage. Economists use two competing models to describe the effects of commercial advertising—advertising as market competition and advertising as market power. The market competition model holds that the fundamental function of advertising is to provide information about products and brands. It is argued that information in ads permits greater marketplace efficiencies, such as lower prices and reduced monopoly power. In a similar vein, much discussion regarding political advertising has rested on its informational value. Does political advertising provide political information and help voters make informed decisions? Nelson argues that promoting bars of soap in commercial ads is no different than promoting political ideas/ideology from political candidates in political ads, on the grounds that information is being distributed in both cases. Others, such as Ferguson and Jamieson, disagree with Nelson's proposition. Ferguson, for example, pointed out that choosing a political candidate is more like buying an experience good (where the quality is hard to evaluate prior to purchase) rather than a search good (where the quality is easily evaluated before the purchase). According to Ferguson, claims in political ads do not have true informational value, because it is difficult for voters to draw inferences about the future deeds of a candidate from what the ads say. Furthermore, Jamieson argues that political ads reshape the public image of political candidates and change voters' feelings about the candidates with subtle emotional cues but without substantive information upon which to base a reasoned judgment.

passage.text: Questions 7 through 9 are based on the following passage. Economists use two competing models to describe the effects of commercial advertising—advertising as market competition and advertising as market power. The market competition model holds that the fundamental function of advertising is to provide information about products and brands. It is argued that information in ads permits greater marketplace efficiencies, such as lower prices and reduced monopoly power.In a similar vein, much discussion regarding political advertising has rested on its informational value. Does political advertising provide political information and help voters make informed decisions? Nelson argues that promoting bars of soap in commercial ads is no different than promoting political ideas/ideology from political candidates in political ads, on the grounds that information is being distributed in both cases. Others, such as Ferguson and Jamieson, disagree with Nelson's proposition. Ferguson, for example, pointed out that choosing a political candidate is more like buying an experience good (where the quality is hard to evaluate prior to purchase) rather than a search good (where the quality is easily evaluated before the purchase). According to Ferguson, claims in political ads do not have true informational value, because it is difficult for voters to draw inferences about the future deeds of a candidate from what the ads say. Furthermore, Jamieson argues that political ads reshape the public image of political candidates and change voters' feelings about the candidates with subtle emotional cues but without substantive information upon which to base a reasoned judgment.

passage.text: Though respectful of the groundbreaking work in translating Native American oral narratives done by Dell Hymes and Dennis Tedlock in the 1970s, Robert Parker notes that their work emerged when "Romanticized ideas of'the Indian'... and of poetry" converged to create a surprisingly uncritical reception of their claim that Native American stories are in fact poetry. Parker objects that by claiming to discover poetry as the true nature of Native American narrative and asserting the value of such narrative on that ground, Hymes and Tedlock "misconstrue the social relation between power, genre, and value." Parker's own position is that Native American literature, on its own terms, matches the best canonical literature in the European tradition and need not be validated by that tradition's notions of value.

answer.rationale_zh: 帕克批评海姆斯和泰德洛克把原住民叙事说成“诗歌”，并正是以这一点来断言其价值；他认为这种做法让欧洲传统对诗歌的价值观充当了验证标准。因此选 A。

translation.passage_zh: 罗伯特·帕克尊重戴尔·海姆斯和丹尼斯·泰德洛克在 1970 年代翻译美洲原住民口述叙事的开创性工作，但他指出：他们的工作出现于对“印第安人”和诗歌的浪漫化观念交汇之时，因此他们“美洲原住民故事事实上是诗歌”的主张得到了出人意料而缺乏批判性的接受。帕克反对他们把发现诗歌当作美洲原住民叙事的真实本质，并据此断言这类叙事的价值；他认为这误解了权力、体裁与价值之间的社会关系。帕克自己的立场是，美洲原住民文学按其自身标准足以匹敌欧洲传统中最优秀的经典文学，无须由该传统的价值观来确认。

translation.passage_zh: Robert Parker 虽然尊重 Dell Hymes 和 Dennis Tedlock 在二十世纪七十年代翻译美洲原住民口述叙事所做的开创性工作，却指出：他们的工作出现于一种特殊时期，当时对“印第安人”和诗歌的浪漫化观念汇合，导致人们对他们“原住民故事实际上是诗歌”的主张作出了令人惊讶的不加批判的接受。Parker 反对这种观点，因为 Hymes 和 Tedlock 通过宣称发现了诗歌才是原住民叙事的真实本质，并据此确认其价值，“误解了权力、体裁与价值之间的社会关系”。Parker 本人的立场是，美洲原住民文学依其自身标准足以与欧洲传统中最优秀的经典文学匹敌，无须由该传统的价值观念来确认其价值。

passage.text: Most feminist labor historians believe that the emergence and rapid general adoption of industrial unionism in the late 1930s was essential for the success of efforts to organize large numbers of women workers into unions. They argue that industrial unionism's commitment to recruiting unskilled workers and its abandonment of racial and gender exclusiveness was more attractive to women workers (who, according to these scholars, were largely unskilled) than was the earlier exclusionary craft-union model. The successful organization of women garment workers in the 1910s does not undermine this dominant view, since the garment unions welcomed women workers of every skill level, prefiguring the industrial form of unionism. However, the fact that another organization, the very successful Women's Trade Union League, effectively recruited in other industries using the then-prevalent craft-union approach—setting performance standards for members, offering them advanced training programs, and disciplining members who had substandard job performance—is less easily explained.

answer.label: B
answer.text: presenting evidence related to a belief about the unionization of women workers
answer.rationale_zh: 文章先概述女性主义劳工史家的主导信念：工业工会主义对大规模组织女工至关重要；随后给出制衣工会与妇女工会联盟的事实，其中后者难以由该信念解释。文章的核心是在呈现与这一信念相关的证据，故选 B。

translation.passage_zh: 大多数女性主义劳工史家认为，工业工会主义在 1930 年代末出现并迅速普及，是组织大量女工加入工会取得成功的关键。他们认为，工业工会主义致力于吸收非熟练工人、并放弃种族和性别排他性；相较早期排他的技工工会模式，这对女工更有吸引力（这些学者认为女工大多是非熟练工）。1910 年代成功组织女制衣工人的事实并不动摇这一主导观点，因为制衣工会接纳各种技能水平的女工，预示了工业工会主义的形式。然而，另一个非常成功的组织——妇女工会联盟——在其他行业有效招募成员时采用的却是当时盛行的技工工会方法：为成员设定绩效标准、提供进阶培训，并处分工作表现不合格的成员；这一事实就不那么容易解释了。

passage.text: Faced with the paucity of surviving texts by mid- eighteenth-century American women, historians interested in women's experience have proven resourceful at using nontextual sources. Recently, Laurel Thatcher Ulrich has turned to objects hand-sewn by New England women, maintaining that objects such as sheets, pillowcases, and quilts reveal the "flow of common life" while providing a context for political events. Discerning the historical significance of these handmade objects is not easy, however. Between today and eighteenth-century New England there looms a formidable nineteenth-century mythology that romanticized that earlier, colonial era, with its household production system, as a simpler time of hard work and virtuous self-sufficiency. This myth emerged as compensation for the extreme wealth and poverty generated by industrialization. As household production declined, and factory-made, store-bought goods became widespread, antiquarians avidly collected and displayed the handmade objects of their idealized forebears. Attentive to the ideological distortions of nineteenth-century mythmaking, most historians are wary of trying to discern the original meaning of colonial objects, assuming that, nowadays, such objects reveal more about nineteenth-century collectors than about eighteenth-century users. By contrast, rather than disparaging the mythmakers, Ulrich thanks them for saving so many objects made and used by ordinary women.

translation.passage_zh: 由于十八世纪中叶美国女性留下的文本很少，关注女性经历的历史学家在使用非文字资料方面表现得很有办法。近来，劳雷尔·撒切尔·乌尔里希转而研究新英格兰女性手缝的物品；她认为床单、枕套和被子等物品能揭示“普通生活的流动”，同时为政治事件提供背景。不过，辨析这些手工物品的历史意义并不容易。在今天与十八世纪的新英格兰之间，横亘着一种强大的十九世纪神话：它把拥有家庭生产体系的早期殖民时代浪漫化为一个辛勤劳动、道德自足的简单时代。这一神话是为补偿工业化造成的极端贫富分化而出现的。随着家庭生产衰落、工厂制造和商店购买的商品普及，古物收藏家热衷于收藏和展示他们理想化祖先的手工物品。大多数历史学家注意到十九世纪造神的意识形态扭曲，因此不愿试图辨析殖民时期物品的原始含义；他们认为如今这些物品更多揭示的是十九世纪的收藏者，而非十八世纪的使用者。相比之下，乌尔里希没有贬斥那些造神者，反而感谢他们保存了这么多普通女性制作和使用过的物品。

translation.passage_zh: 面对十八世纪中叶美国女性留下的文本极少这一状况，关注女性经验的历史学家在使用非文本资料方面颇有创意。近来，劳雷尔·撒切尔·乌尔里希转而研究新英格兰女性手工缝制的物件，认为床单、枕套和被子等物件既揭示“日常生活的流动”，又为政治事件提供背景。不过，辨识这些手工物件的历史意义并不容易。在今天与十八世纪的新英格兰之间，横亘着一种强大的十九世纪神话：它把拥有家庭生产体系的更早殖民时期浪漫化为一个更简单、勤劳且自给自足的时代。这一神话是对工业化造成的极端财富与贫困的补偿。随着家庭生产衰落、工厂制造和商店购买的商品普及，古物收藏家热衷于收集和展示被理想化的祖先留下的手工物件。由于注意到十九世纪造神活动带来的意识形态扭曲，大多数历史学家谨慎地不去辨认殖民时期物件最初的含义，认为如今这些物件揭示的更多是十九世纪收藏家，而非十八世纪使用者。与之相反，乌尔里希没有贬低这些造神者，反而感谢他们保存了如此多普通女性制作和使用的物件。

passage.text: Faced with the paucity of surviving texts by mid- eighteenth-century American women, historians interested in women's experience have proven resourceful at using nontextual sources. Recently, Laurel Thatcher Ulrich has turned to objects hand-sewn by New England women, maintaining that objects such as sheets, pillowcases, and quilts reveal the "flow of common life" while providing a context for political events. Discerning the historical significance of these handmade objects is not easy, however. Between today and eighteenth-century New England there looms a formidable nineteenth-century mythology that romanticized that earlier, colonial era, with its household production system, as a simpler time of hard work and virtuous self-sufficiency. This myth emerged as compensation for the extreme wealth and poverty generated by industrialization. As household production declined, and factory-made, store-bought goods became widespread, antiquarians avidly collected and displayed the handmade objects of their idealized forebears. Attentive to the ideological distortions of nineteenth-century mythmaking, most historians are wary of trying to discern the original meaning of colonial objects, assuming that, nowadays, such objects reveal more about nineteenth-century collectors than about eighteenth-century users. By contrast, rather than disparaging the mythmakers, Ulrich thanks them for saving so many objects made and used by ordinary women.

options.label: C
options.text: whether this myth contains clues to the original meaning of handmade objects from the colonial period

options.label: D
options.text: whether this myth was especially widespread during the nineteenth century

options.label: E
options.text: whether this myth was able to compensate adequately for the inequities of industrialization

answer.label: A
answer.text: the extent to which this myth interferes with the use of certain objects as historical source material

passage.text: A law has been proposed requiring the cargo boxes of trucks carrying gravel to be covered by a tarpaulin, because vehicles driving close behind open-topped gravel trucks can be damaged by gravel flying off these trucks. options.label: E

answer.rationale_zh: 论证的结论是盖住货箱不会显著减少损害，因为碎石主要来自轮胎沟槽。若盖篷布反而让后车更愿意紧跟卡车，后车仍会更容易受到轮胎飞石的伤害，这直接加强了该法律难以减少损害的判断。

translation.passage_zh: 有人提出一项法律，要求载运碎石的卡车用防水篷布覆盖货箱，因为紧随敞顶碎石卡车的车辆可能被飞出的碎石损坏。然而，这项法律不大可能显著减少这种损害：飞出的碎石比起来自货箱本身，更可能来自轮胎沟槽；碎石会在装载过程中卡进这些沟槽。

options_zh.label: E

passage.text: Studies show that liking increases with familiarity for many classes of objects but not for representational paintings. Representational paintings have meaning, a factor that might idiosyncratically affect one's liking for an artwork independent of its familiarity. A person who does not like flowers might not like van Gogh's paintings of sunflowers no matter how familiar they are. Thus, preference for a painting's content might conceal the effects of familiarity. Furthermore, art is embedded in a cultural context that might contribute to the effects of individual taste and general knowledge on judgments of liking. Some people might dislike the famous van Gogh paintings because they think the paintings are commercially exploited or because they' ve heard the paintings are fakes.

answer.rationale_zh: 作者先提出艺术嵌入文化语境，而文化语境会影响人们的喜好；随后以有人因认为梵高画作被商业利用或是假画而不喜欢它们为例。该例的主要功能正是说明文化语境如何影响喜欢与否。

translation.passage_zh: 研究表明，对许多类别的物体而言，熟悉程度会提高喜爱程度，但具象绘画并非如此。具象画有内容意义，这一因素可能以个人特有的方式影响一个人对艺术品的喜爱，而与熟悉程度无关。一个不喜欢花的人，无论对梵高的《向日葵》多么熟悉，都可能不喜欢它。因此，对画作内容的偏好可能掩盖熟悉程度的影响。此外，艺术嵌入一种文化语境，这种语境可能使个人品味和一般知识影响人们对喜爱的判断。有些人可能不喜欢著名的梵高画作，因为他们认为这些画被商业性利用，或者因为他们听说这些画是赝品。

passage.text: Studies show that liking increases with familiarity for many classes of objects but not for representational paintings. Representational paintings have meaning, a factor that might idiosyncratically affect one's liking for an artwork independent of its familiarity. A person who does not like flowers might not like van Gogh's paintings of sunflowers no matter how familiar they are. Thus, preference for a painting's content might conceal the effects of familiarity. Furthermore, art is embedded in a cultural context that might contribute to the effects of individual taste and general knowledge on judgments of liking. Some people might dislike the famous van Gogh paintings because they think the paintings are commercially exploited or because they' ve heard the paintings are fakes.

translation.passage_zh: 研究表明，对许多类别的物体，人们越熟悉便越喜欢；但具象绘画不是如此。具象绘画具有意义，这一因素可能以个人特有的方式影响一个人对作品的喜爱，而与熟悉程度无关。不喜欢花的人，无论多么熟悉梵高的向日葵画作，也可能不喜欢它们。因此，对绘画内容的偏好可能掩盖熟悉程度的影响。此外，艺术嵌入文化语境，个人品味和一般知识可能会因此影响喜欢与否的判断。有些人可能不喜欢著名的梵高画作，因为他们认为这些画作被商业化利用，或因为他们听说这些画是赝品。

answer.rationale_zh: 学徒经历说明埃利森曾认真投入视觉艺术，作者借此避免把他拒绝《隐形人》的视觉改编误读为他对视觉艺术本身漠不关心。故该细节是对其保留态度的限定。

translation.passage_zh: 拉尔夫·埃利森热衷于视觉艺术。他在二十世纪三十年代沉浸于哈莱姆艺术圈，甚至一度随雕塑家里士满·巴泰当学徒。然而，他对试图以视觉形式呈现其小说《隐形人》的项目抱有警惕。他勉强允许富兰克林图书馆出版该小说的两个插图版本，却觉得结果令人失望，并一再拒绝该书的电影改编提案。尽管参与视觉艺术，埃利森仍坚持只有语言能捕捉美国身份的复杂性。这种复杂性来自两者碰撞所形成的张力：一方面是建国文件所阐明的美国书面理想，另一方面是塑造国民意识的历史与当代经验。

options_zh.label: D

passage.text: Nineteenth-century historian Jacob Burckhardt's remarkable assertion that "women stood on a footing of perfect equality with men" in sixteenth-century Italy resulted from his close identification with the early humanists—a small, elite group in Renaissance Italy. Ironically, as Margaret King has shown, humanist texts actually reflect inequalities between men and women; one example is the programs of study recommended for girls. A pedagogic imperative like Leonardo Bruni's—that women should study the liberal arts as men did with the exception of rhetoric, which "lies wholly outside the province of women"—went unnoticed by Burckhardt because he shared the humanist assumption that women's province was the private sphere rather than the public sphere. The relegation of women to a "private" sphere was a complex historical phenomenon that should be analyzed in light of other social and economic changes occurring during the Renaissance. Historians desirous of understanding women's experience cannot view the period, as Burckhardt did, through the lens provided by the humanists.

answer.label: C
answer.text: Rhetoric is useful primarily in the public sphere rather than in the private sphere.
answer.rationale_zh: 布鲁尼主张女性可以学习自由艺术，唯独修辞学“完全不属于女性的领域”；文段说明人文主义者把女性领域视为私人而非公共领域。因此可推断他认为修辞学主要适用于公共领域。

translation.passage_zh: 十九世纪历史学家雅各布·布克哈特曾断言，十六世纪意大利“女性与男性处于完全平等的地位”。这一惊人的断言源于他与早期人文主义者——文艺复兴意大利的一个小型精英群体——的紧密认同。具有讽刺意味的是，正如玛格丽特·金所表明的，人文主义文本实际上反映了男女不平等；给女孩建议的学习课程便是一例。莱昂纳多·布鲁尼提出一种教育要求：女性应像男性一样学习自由艺术，但修辞学除外，因为修辞学“完全不属于女性的领域”。布克哈特没有注意到这一点，因为他也接受了人文主义者的假设，即女性的领域是私人领域而不是公共领域。把女性归入“私人”领域是一个复杂的历史现象，应结合文艺复兴时期发生的其他社会和经济变化来分析。想理解女性经验的历史学家，不能像布克哈特那样透过人文主义者提供的镜头看待这一时期。

passage.text: Since the 1970s, there has been a movement in African literary studies toward the recognition of national literatures in newly independent African states, such as Cameroon, Senegal, and Benin. But while in some of these national literatures there has undoubtedly emerged a sense of corporate identity, often marked by clear thematic and formal progressions, it remains an incontrovertible fact that the European languages in which these literatures are expressed have only an official acceptance: they are neither indigenous to the cultures on which they have been imposed, nor are they national in any real sense of the word. passage.text: The post-1850 economic boom in the United States had its greatest impact on eastern mill towns, such as Lowell, Massachusetts. Formerly peaceful villages became bustling towns whose factories rose to dominate their skylines. Their populations sometimes tripled in a decade, forcing propertyless workers into overcrowded, dilapidated housing. Their economies came under the domination of industrialists who competed unfairly with one another and were contemptuous of the old ways. These industrialists had economic power and the social and political power that accompanied it; town politicians catered to their interests. Other property owners, especially small-business entrepreneurs and professionals, identified with them and applauded their successes. The factory workers inevitably found themselves alienated from property owners and helpless before their employers. Thus, economic class, social status, and power were inextricably intertwined; control over property and machinery was readily transformed into complete authority.

options.label: B

answer.label: B
answer.text: possess political and social power
answer.rationale_zh: 文段直接说工业家拥有经济权力，以及随之而来的社会和政治权力，镇上政客还迎合他们的利益。因此答案是 B。

translation.passage_zh: 1850年后美国的经济繁荣对马萨诸塞州洛厄尔等东部纺织城镇影响最大。原本宁静的村庄变成了繁忙的城镇，工厂拔地而起，雄踞天际线。人口有时十年内增加到三倍，迫使无财产的工人挤进拥挤破败的住房。当地经济落入工业家的支配；这些人彼此进行不公平竞争，并轻蔑旧有方式。他们不仅拥有经济权力，也拥有随之而来的社会和政治权力；镇上的政客迎合其利益。其他财产所有者，特别是小企业主和专业人士，认同他们并赞赏其成功。工厂工人不可避免地同有产者疏离，在雇主面前无能为力。因此，经济阶层、社会地位和权力密不可分；对财产和机器的控制很容易转化为完全的权威。

passage.text: Scientists have long debated the exact timing of the lunar cataclysm, a period approximately 4 billion years ago when Earth and the Moon were pummeled with asteroids. A clue to this puzzle may come from spherules, millimeter-sized droplets of molten rock formed after an asteroid collides explosively with a planet. Upon impact, the asteroid vaporizes both itself and the target rock, producing a vapor plume that condenses into spherules. These form a layer preserved in rock, whose age can be estimated using radiometric dating. Scientists know of fourteen of these spherule layers scattered across Earth, but none dates to the theorized lunar cataclysm time period. Four layers, however, are from between 3.47 and 3.24 billion years ago, indicating perhaps a slow decline in collisions.

translation.passage_zh: 科学家长期争论月球大灾变发生的确切时间；约40亿年前，地球和月球遭到小行星密集撞击。解开这一问题的线索可能来自球粒：小行星与行星发生爆炸性碰撞后形成的毫米级熔融岩滴。撞击时，小行星及目标岩石都会汽化，形成蒸汽羽流，后者冷凝为球粒。球粒形成保存在岩石中的一层，其年龄可用放射性测年估算。科学家已知地球各处有十四层这样的球粒层，但没有一层属于理论上的月球大灾变时期。不过其中四层形成于34.7亿至32.4亿年前，这或许表明撞击次数在缓慢减少。

passage.text: Nineteenth-century historian Jacob Burckhardt's remarkable assertion that "women stood on a footing of perfect equality with men" in sixteenth-century Italy resulted from his close identification with the early humanists—a small, elite group in Renaissance Italy. Ironically, as Margaret King has shown, humanist texts actually reflect inequalities between men and women; one example is the programs of study recommended for girls. A pedagogic imperative like Leonardo Bruni's—that women should study the liberal arts as men did with the exception of rhetoric, which "lies wholly outside the province of women"—went unnoticed by Burckhardt because he shared the humanist assumption that women's province was the private sphere rather than the public sphere. The relegation of women to a "private" sphere was a complex historical phenomenon that should be analyzed in light of other social and economic changes occurring during the Renaissance. Historians desirous of understanding women's experience cannot view the period, as Burckhardt did, through the lens provided by the humanists.

translation.passage_zh: 十九世纪历史学家雅各布·布克哈特曾断言，十六世纪意大利“女性与男性处于完全平等的地位”。这一惊人的断言源于他与早期人文主义者——文艺复兴意大利的一个小型精英群体——的紧密认同。具有讽刺意味的是，正如玛格丽特·金所表明的，人文主义文本实际上反映了男女不平等；给女孩建议的学习课程便是一例。莱昂纳多·布鲁尼提出一种教育要求：女性应像男性一样学习自由艺术，但修辞学除外，因为修辞学“完全不属于女性的领域”。布克哈特没有注意到这一点，因为他也接受了人文主义者的假设，即女性的领域是私人领域而不是公共领域。把女性归入“私人”领域是一个复杂的历史现象，应结合文艺复兴时期发生的其他社会和经济变化来分析。想理解女性经验的历史学家，不能像布克哈特那样透过人文主义者提供的镜头看待这一时期。

options_zh.label: D

options_zh.label: E

passage.text: Nineteenth-century historian Jacob Burckhardt's remarkable assertion that "women stood on a footing of perfect equality with men" in sixteenth-century Italy resulted from his close identification with the early humanists—a small, elite group in Renaissance Italy. Ironically, as Margaret King has shown, humanist texts actually reflect inequalities between men and women; one example is the programs of study recommended for girls. A pedagogic imperative like Leonardo Bruni's—that women should study the liberal arts as men did with the exception of rhetoric, which "lies wholly outside the province of women"—went unnoticed by Burckhardt because he shared the humanist assumption that women's province was the private sphere rather than the public sphere. The relegation of women to a "private" sphere was a complex historical phenomenon that should be analyzed in light of other social and economic changes occurring during the Renaissance. Historians desirous of understanding women's experience cannot view the period, as Burckhardt did, through the lens provided by the humanists.

answer.label: E

passage.text: The post-1850 economic boom in the United States had its greatest impact on eastern mill towns, such as Lowell, Massachusetts. Formerly peaceful villages became bustling towns whose factories rose to dominate their skylines. Their populations sometimes tripled in a decade, forcing propertyless workers into overcrowded, dilapidated housing. Their economies came under the domination of industrialists who competed unfairly with one another and were contemptuous of the old ways. These industrialists had economic power and the social and political power that accompanied it; town politicians catered to their interests. Other property owners, especially small-business entrepreneurs and professionals, identified with them and applauded their successes. The factory workers inevitably found themselves alienated from property owners and helpless before their employers. Thus, economic class, social status, and power were inextricably intertwined; control over property and machinery was readily transformed into complete authority.

options.label: B
options.text: find their power resisted by propertyless workers

options.label: C
options.text: compete with the interests of the propertied business and

answer.label: B
answer.text: possess political and social power
answer.rationale_zh: 文段直接说工业家拥有经济权力，以及随之而来的社会和政治权力，镇上政客还迎合他们的利益。因此答案是 B。

passage.text: Scientists have long debated the exact timing of the lunar cataclysm, a period approximately 4 billion years ago when Earth and the Moon were pummeled with asteroids. A clue to this puzzle may come from spherules, millimeter-sized droplets of molten rock formed after an asteroid collides explosively with a planet. Upon impact, the asteroid vaporizes both itself and the target rock, producing a vapor plume that condenses into spherules. These form a layer preserved in rock, whose age can be estimated using radiometric dating. Scientists know of fourteen of these spherule layers scattered across Earth, but none dates to the theorized lunar cataclysm time period. Four layers, however, are from between 3.47 and 3.24 billion years ago, indicating perhaps a slow decline in collisions.

passage.text: Early archaeologists studying prehistoric Mesoamerica applied the term "Olmec" to various artifacts of unknown provenance exhibiting an art style distinct from previously known styles of central Mexican cultures. Later, mid-twentieth-century archaeologists began excavating sites in Mexico's Gulf Coast lowlands, where monumental sculptures with attributes of this distinct style were discovered. Consequently, the Gulf Coast region was identified as the Olmec civilization's homeland. Thereafter, artifacts exhibiting this style from anywhere beyond the Gulf Coast have been assumed to represent Olmec influence. Although artifact dating is often problematic, Olmec-style objects from outside the homeland are often judged to be either contemporary with Olmec civilization or derived from it. Therefore, some objects are assumed to reflect Olmec origins for cultural developments in areas outside the Gulf Coast.

passage.text: The late zoologist Sidnie Manton acknowledged that arthropods—animals with jointed exoskeletons, such as flies, crabs, and spiders—are all descended from soft- bodied segmented worms. Yet he maintained that differences in limb form, musculature, and embryonic development indicate that these three arthropod groups —insects, crustaceans, and chelicerates, respectively— evolved independently from worms rather than from a common arthropod ancestor. Consequently, according to Manton, shared characteristics such as a jointed exoskeleton and large compound eyes represent cases of convergent evolution—similar yet independent developments—in these organisms. But if they evolved convergently, then one would expect significant differences in the neurological systems supporting sight. In fact, however, many nerve cells play virtually identical roles in supporting complex visual responses in both insects and crustaceans, suggesting that their common ancp'p sod oand therefore was probably already an arthropod. Yet the compound eyes of chelicerates differ neurologically from those of insects and crustaceans, suggesting that the eyes of chelicerates did evolve independently and providing partial confirmation of Manton's views.

translation.passage_zh: 已故动物学家西德尼·曼顿承认，节肢动物——具有分节外骨骼的动物，如苍蝇、螃蟹和蜘蛛——都源自软体分节蠕虫。但他坚持认为，肢体形态、肌肉组织和胚胎发育方面的差异表明，昆虫、甲壳类和螯肢类这三类节肢动物分别是从蠕虫独立进化而来，而非来自共同的节肢动物祖先。因此，按曼顿的说法，关节外骨骼和大型复眼等共有特征，是这些生物中趋同进化的例子：相似却彼此独立的发展。可是，如果它们是趋同进化而来，人们应当预期支持视觉的神经系统存在显著差异。事实上，许多神经细胞在昆虫和甲壳类中承担几乎相同的复杂视觉反应功能，这表明它们的共同祖先已具有高度发达的眼睛，因此很可能已是节肢动物。不过，螯肢类的复眼在神经学上与昆虫和甲壳类不同，说明螯肢类的眼睛确实是独立进化的，并由此部分印证了曼顿的观点。

passage.text: The late zoologist Sidnie Manton acknowledged that arthropods—animals with jointed exoskeletons, such as flies, crabs, and spiders—are all descended from soft- bodied segmented worms. Yet he maintained that differences in limb form, musculature, and embryonic development indicate that these three arthropod groups —insects, crustaceans, and chelicerates, respectively— evolved independently from worms rather than from a common arthropod ancestor. Consequently, according to Manton, shared characteristics such as a jointed exoskeleton and large compound eyes represent cases of convergent evolution—similar yet independent developments—in these organisms. But if they evolved convergently, then one would expect significant differences in the neurological systems supporting sight. In fact, however, many nerve cells play virtually identical roles in supporting complex visual responses in both insects and crustaceans, suggesting that their common ancp'p sod oand therefore was probably already an arthropod. Yet the compound eyes of chelicerates differ neurologically from those of insects and crustaceans, suggesting that the eyes of chelicerates did evolve independently and providing partial confirmation of Manton's views.

translation.passage_zh: 已故动物学家西德尼·曼顿承认，节肢动物——具有分节外骨骼的动物，如苍蝇、螃蟹和蜘蛛——都源自软体分节蠕虫。但他坚持认为，肢体形态、肌肉组织和胚胎发育方面的差异表明，昆虫、甲壳类和螯肢类这三类节肢动物分别是从蠕虫独立进化而来，而非来自共同的节肢动物祖先。因此，按曼顿的说法，关节外骨骼和大型复眼等共有特征，是这些生物中趋同进化的例子：相似却彼此独立的发展。可是，如果它们是趋同进化而来，人们应当预期支持视觉的神经系统存在显著差异。事实上，许多神经细胞在昆虫和甲壳类中承担几乎相同的复杂视觉反应功能，这表明它们的共同祖先已具有高度发达的眼睛，因此很可能已是节肢动物。不过，螯肢类的复眼在神经学上与昆虫和甲壳类不同，说明螯肢类的眼睛确实是独立进化的，并由此部分印证了曼顿的观点。

passage.text: The two primary theoretical traditions that frame research about audience exposure to television carry differential assumptions of how television viewers use the medium. The uses and gratifications approach conceptualizes the audience as active and goal directed when consuming media and offers an understanding of how audience motivations, individual characteristics, and preferences link to media behavior. Findings demonstrate considerable audience activity in decisions about whether to watch television, especially involving program—or program type—preferences. However, studies in this tradition empirically ignore that exposure is not completely free of constraints. Structural or contextual factors, such as the audience member's availability and access to television or other media, the ability or willingness to pay for multichannel services, as well as scheduling factors, impact use of television. Scholars who focus on these structural determinants use aggregate data (usually secondary analyses supplied by Nielsen) to demonstrate consistent patterns of macrolevel audience behavior. Findings from this approach usually have impressive predictive power and utility for explaining the mass audience but are ill-suited to explain the underlying reasons for medium or program choice, including individual motivations for selecting television in the first place.

translation.passage_zh: 关于观众接触电视的研究，主要有两种理论传统，它们对电视观众如何使用这一媒介抱持不同的假设。“使用与满足”取向把观众视为在媒介消费中积极、目标导向的主体，并解释观众动机、个人特征和偏好如何与媒介行为相联系。研究结果显示，观众在是否看电视，特别是在节目或节目类型偏好方面，具有相当大的主动性。不过，该传统的研究在实证上忽略了：接触媒介并非完全不受约束。结构或情境因素，如观众是否有时间以及能否接触电视或其他媒介、是否有能力或意愿支付多频道服务费用，以及节目编排因素，都会影响电视使用。关注这些结构决定因素的学者利用诸如尼尔森收视数据之类的数据，来展示宏观层面的观众行为存在稳定模式。这一取向的发现通常在解释大众受众方面具有很强的预测力和实用性，却不适合解释媒介或节目的选择背后更深层的理由，包括人们最初选择电视的个人动机。

passage.text: The two primary theoretical traditions that frame research about audience exposure to television carry differential assumptions of how television viewers use the medium. The uses and gratifications approach conceptualizes the audience as active and goal directed when consuming media and offers an understanding of how audience motivations, individual characteristics, and preferences link to media behavior. Findings demonstrate considerable audience activity in decisions about whether to watch television, especially involving program—or program type—preferences. However, studies in this tradition empirically ignore that exposure is not completely free of constraints. Structural or contextual factors, such as the audience member's availability and access to television or other media, the ability or willingness to pay for multichannel services, as well as scheduling factors, impact use of television. Scholars who focus on these structural determinants use aggregate data (usually secondary analyses supplied by Nielsen) to demonstrate consistent patterns of macrolevel audience behavior. Findings from this approach usually have impressive predictive power and utility for explaining the mass audience but are ill-suited to explain the underlying reasons for medium or program choice, including individual motivations for selecting television in the first place.

translation.passage_zh: 野生植物的种子通常有厚种皮，使其能在地里存活到下一个生长季。但对驯化植物而言，种子直到生长季开始才会播种。因此，在同一驯化物种内，种皮较薄、发芽更快的植株更有优势；较快发芽使植株能遮蔽发芽较慢的邻株，从而增加其存活到收获并将种子贡献给下一次播种的可能性。

passage.text: Experiments and field observations show that in a Mediterranean plant community, drought has a counterintuitively positive effect on shrub seedling establishment. Due to decreased competition by annuals, droughts increase opportunities for shrub seedlings. Under nondrought conditions, annuals competed with shrub seedlings more effectively, confirming the experimenters' assumption that annuals benefit more than shrub seedlings from an increase in water availability. This may be attributed to their faster or more efficient uptake of soil resources. Similar patterns can be observed in other semi-arid communities. Jurena and Archer showed for a savanna community that root biomass of grasses increased in wetter conditions, decreasing grassland susceptibility to encroachment by shrub seedlings.

passage.text: This passage discusses Minoan buildings constructed during the Bronze Age on the Greek island of Crete. Although the term "Palace" is widely used and deeply ingrained in Minoan archaeology, Driessen has remarked that the term has been used to describe a number of quite different things and that there is no consensus on what the term signifies. The debate usually centers on the presumed functions of the buildings. Evans assumed that the buildings known as Palaces had several roles, including royal residences, administrative centers, economic centers, manufacturing centers, and cult centers. Over the years, each of those functions has been called into question. For example, I. Schoep notes, "The use of the term Palace carries with it a whole host of perhaps unhelpful baggage, which consciously or unconsciously encourages interpretation of the'Palace' as the residence of a royal elite, occupying supreme position within a hierarchical social and political structure"; she suggests using the more neutral term "court-centered building" instead. The problem, however, comes not from the architectural label one applies, but from making unwarranted assumptions about how the Palaces were used. I use the word "Palaces" (capitalized to signal its arbitrariness) not to imply a range of functions but to refer to a group of buildings that share a set of formal elements.

They possess a discernible architectural cohesiveness They probably all had the same or a similar function. answer.label: A

passage.text: What is really meant by "ownership" of works of art? When a museum or an art gallery takes refuge in the argument that something it possesses has been legitimately acquired by the standards of its day and has been properly cared for ever since, it is not a trivial piece of special pleading, but a valid appeal to our sense of fairness. This sort of claim can be strengthened when a museum returns other objects not acquired lawfully. Such concessions recognize that injustices can occur, and they serve to undergird legitimate claims rather than undermine them. But even with legitimate claims, possession of art is not out-and-out ownership, but a duty of care, since stewardship comes as the counterpart of possession.

passage.text: Although many hypotheses have been proposed to explain why some plant communities are more susceptible than others to invasion by nonnative species, results from field studies have been inconsistent and no general theory of invasibility has yet emerged. However, a theory based on fluctuating resource availability could integrate most existing hypotheses and successfully resolve many of the apparently conflicting and ambiguous results of previous studies. The suggested theory is that a plant community becomes more susceptible to invasion whenever there is an increase in the amount of unused resources. The diversity in the range of resource-release mechanisms could partly explain the absence of consistent ecological correlates of invasibility. In particular, the theory predicts that there will be no necessary relationship between the species diversity of a plant community and its susceptibility to invasion, since near-complete exploitation of resources and very incomplete resource exploitation can each occur in both species-rich and species-poor communities. Though Lonsdale found a positive association between species richness and invasion, this may arise from the tendency of diverse plant communities to be nutrient poor and therefore more responsive to the effects of human- caused influxes of nutrients.

translation.passage_zh: 尽管已经提出许多假说来解释为何有些植物群落比其他群落更容易遭受非本地物种入侵，实地研究的结果却并不一致，至今尚未出现普遍适用的可入侵性理论。不过，基于资源可利用性波动的理论可以整合现有大部分假说，并成功解释以往研究中表面相互矛盾、含混的许多结果。这一理论认为，只要未被利用的资源量增加，植物群落就会更容易受到入侵。资源释放机制的多样性可部分解释为何找不到可入侵性的一致生态关联。尤其是，由于资源近乎被完全利用和资源利用极不充分这两种情况都可能出现在物种丰富或物种贫乏的群落中，该理论预测植物群落的物种多样性与其对入侵的易感性之间并无必然联系。尽管 Lonsdale 发现物种丰富度与入侵之间存在正相关，这可能是因为多样的植物群落往往养分贫乏，因而对人为造成的养分流入更敏感。

passage.text: Although many hypotheses have been proposed to explain why some plant communities are more susceptible than others to invasion by nonnative species, results from field studies have been inconsistent and no general theory of invasibility has yet emerged. However, a theory based on fluctuating resource availability could integrate most existing hypotheses and successfully resolve many of the apparently conflicting and ambiguous results of previous studies. The suggested theory is that a plant community becomes more susceptible to invasion whenever there is an increase in the amount of unused resources. The diversity in the range of resource-release mechanisms could partly explain the absence of consistent ecological correlates of invasibility. In particular, the theory predicts that there will be no necessary relationship between the species diversity of a plant community and its susceptibility to invasion, since near-complete exploitation of resources and very incomplete resource exploitation can each occur in both species-rich and species-poor communities. Though Lonsdale found a positive association between species richness and invasion, this may arise from the tendency of diverse plant communities to be nutrient poor and therefore more responsive to the effects of human- caused influxes of nutrients.

passage.text: Mark Twain relished the huge cutthroat trout fished from Lake Tahoe but reported them uncommonly difficult to catch. Tahoe's extraordinary clarity may be one reason: Twain thought it an advantage that he could see the trout but did not realize that they could see him. Light bends when it enters water, rendering floating objects outside a given circle invisible from underwater. The radius of such a circle, known as Snell's Window, expands with the relative depth of the viewer's position. The Tahoe cutthroats lived very deep and could have seen Twain's boat long before it came to rest overhead. Moreover, the eyes of trout continue to grow along with their overall body size, and larger eyes, having more cones, provide sharper vision.

passage.text: Change in the level of urbanization (the proportion of the population inhabiting towns) following the mid- fourteenth-century plague epidemic in England is a contentious issue. Some scholars argue that high urban mortality levels combined with reduced rural-to-urban migration may have meant a decline in England's urbanization. Alternatively it can be maintained that the cloth industry's expansion and a general rise in living standards in the late fourteenth century may have increased per capita demand for urban goods and services. Given the direct correlation between rising incomes and a growth in urbanization, which has been seen as typical of preindustrial economies, it is thus possible that, even if England's urban population underwent an absolute decline in this period, the urban sector still grew in relative terms.

passage.text: The poet Paul Laurence Dunbar (1872-1906) was the premier Black writer of poetry that used the dialect of rural African Americans of the southern United States. Although Dunbar's works were both popular with readers and acclaimed by literary critics during his lifetime, after the First World War a radical shift occurred, at least in critical opinion of his poetry, and twentieth- century critical evaluation of his work has been generally negative. Some critics attacked his work on social grounds for failing to challenge plantation stereotypes of African Americans. Other critics, such as the poet James Weldon Johnson, argued from aesthetic grounds that dialect poetry in general was too limited as an artistic medium, and capable of producing only two effects: pathos and humor. The negative critical trend only began to reverse itself in the 1970s, when scholars began to emphasize the importance of mythic, psychological, and historical dimensions of Dunbar's works, focusing on the interior and exterior realities of African American life after the Civil War.

answer.label: B
answer.text: Dialect poetry is highly limited in the number of artistic effects it can produce.
answer.rationale_zh: 文章直接提到 Johnson 的美学批评：方言诗作为艺术媒介过于受限，只能产生悲怆和幽默两种效果，正对应 B。

translation.passage_zh: 诗人保罗·劳伦斯·邓巴（1872—1906）是使用美国南部农村非裔美国人方言写诗的首要黑人诗人。邓巴的作品在他生前既受读者欢迎，也获得文学评论家的赞誉；但第一次世界大战后，至少在对其诗歌的评论意见上发生了根本转变，20 世纪对其作品的批评总体上是负面的。一些评论家从社会角度批评他，认为他的作品未能挑战关于非裔美国人的种植园刻板印象。另一些评论家，如诗人 James Weldon Johnson，则从美学角度主张，方言诗作为艺术媒介总体上过于受限，只能产生两种效果：悲怆和幽默。直到 20 世纪 70 年代，负面的批评趋势才开始逆转；当时学者开始强调邓巴作品的神话、心理和历史维度，着重关注内战后非裔美国人生活的内在与外在现实。

options_zh.label: D

options_zh.label: E
options_zh.text_zh: 方言诗只有有限程度的大众吸引力。

passage.text: More appropriate water pricing would promote the treatment and reuse of urban wastewater for agricultural irrigation and also encourage improvements in irrigation efficiency. Treatment and reuse is more expensive than most irrigation-related conservation and efficiency measures but often less expensive than developing new water sources. passage.text: This passage is adapted from an essay published in 2010. As I write, the Large Hadron Collider, the world's biggest atom-smasher at CERN in Geneva, has switched on with almost unprecedented media jamboree. Asked about the practical value of it all, Stephen Hawking has said that "modern society is based on advances in pure science that were not foreseen to have practical applications." It's a common claim, and it subtly reinforces the hierarchy that Medawar identified: technology and engineering are the humble offspring of pure science, the casual cast-offs of a more elevated pursuit. I don' t believe that such pronouncements are intended to denigrate applied science as an intellectual activity; they merely speak into a culture in which that has already happened. Pure science undoubtedly does lead to applied spin-offs, but this is not the norm. Rather, most of our technology has come from explicit and painstaking efforts to develop it. And this is simply a part of the scientific enterprise. A dividing line between pure and applied science makes no sense at all, running as it does in a convoluted path through disciplines, departments, even individual scientific papers and careers. Research aimed at applications fills the pages of the leading journals in physics, chemistry, and the life and Earth sciences; curiosity-driven research with no real practical value is abundant in the "applied" literature of the materials, biotechnological, and engineering

options.label: A
options.text: introduce a change in the prevailing attitude toward

options.label: C
options.text: call into question the currently existing priorities for

answer.label: A
answer.text: demonstrate the attention that is paid to what some consider pure science
answer.rationale_zh: 开头提到大型强子对撞机启动时获得近乎空前的媒体关注，并由此引出对其实际价值的追问；该例首先说明了人们对被视为纯科学之物的关注，选 A。

translation.passage_zh: 本文改编自 2010 年发表的一篇文章。作者写作时，位于日内瓦 CERN 的大型强子对撞机——世界最大的原子对撞机——刚刚启动，引发了几乎前所未有的媒体狂欢。被问及其实际价值时，Stephen Hawking 说："现代社会建立在纯科学的进展之上，而这些进展当初并未预见到会有实际应用。"这是一种常见说法，它微妙地强化了 Medawar 所指出的等级观：技术和工程是纯科学谦卑的后代，是更高尚事业随手丢下的副产品。作者不认为这种说法有意贬低应用科学作为智力活动的地位；它们只是在一个早已发生这种贬低的文化中说话。纯科学当然会带来应用上的衍生结果，但这并非常态。相反，我们的大部分技术来自为开发它而作出的明确且细致的努力。这同样只是科学事业的一部分。纯科学与应用科学之间划一条界线根本没有意义，因为这条线曲折地穿过学科、院系，甚至单篇科学论文和个人职业生涯。以应用为目标的研究充满物理、化学、生命科学和地球科学的顶级期刊；而没有实际价值、由好奇心驱动的研究，也大量出现在材料、生物技术和工程等所谓"应用"领域的文献中。
translation.question_zh: 在文章语境中，提到大型强子对撞机主要是为了……

options_zh.label: A

options_zh.label: C
options_zh.text_zh: 质疑当前为科学研究设定的优先事项。

options_zh.label: D
options_zh.text_zh: 说明应用科学对纯科学作出的贡献。

options_zh.label: E
options_zh.text_zh: 对 Medawar 所指出的等级观提出怀疑。

translation.passage_zh: 本文改编自 2010 年发表的一篇文章。作者写作时，位于日内瓦 CERN 的大型强子对撞机——世界最大的原子对撞机——刚刚启动，引发了几乎前所未有的媒体狂欢。被问及其实际价值时，Stephen Hawking 说："现代社会建立在纯科学的进展之上，而这些进展当初并未预见到会有实际应用。"这是一种常见说法，它微妙地强化了 Medawar 所指出的等级观：技术和工程是纯科学谦卑的后代，是更高尚事业随手丢下的副产品。作者不认为这种说法有意贬低应用科学作为智力活动的地位；它们只是在一个早已发生这种贬低的文化中说话。纯科学当然会带来应用上的衍生结果，但这并非常态。相反，我们的大部分技术来自为开发它而作出的明确且细致的努力。这同样只是科学事业的一部分。纯科学与应用科学之间划一条界线根本没有意义，因为这条线曲折地穿过学科、院系，甚至单篇科学论文和个人职业生涯。以应用为目标的研究充满物理、化学、生命科学和地球科学的顶级期刊；而没有实际价值、由好奇心驱动的研究，也大量出现在材料、生物技术和工程等所谓"应用"领域的文献中。

passage.text: Some scientists speculate that projected increases in atmospheric carbon dioxide levels could increase crop yields and thereby help meet increased demand for food as the world's population rises. Most plant species are classified as either type C3 or C4, each type referring to a distinct photosynthetic pathway. C3 plants (over 90 percent of all plant species) benefit much more from carbon dioxide increases than do C4 plants: experiments suggest that doubled carbon dioxide levels can increase C3 growth rates, and hence C3 crop yields, by 20 to 35 percent, whereas C4 plants— including some important food crops such as maize and sugarcane and many pasture grasses on which livestock herds depend—benefit little. Most information regarding crop response to carbon dioxide comes from experiments in which yield-reducing competition from weeds was not a factor. Site-specific mixes of weed and crop species, crop species' responses to other environmental conditions such as precipitation and temperature, and likely changes in geographic ranges of insect, fungal, and bacterial crop pests as a result of carbon dioxide-related climate change—all these must be considered in projections of crop yields in the future carbon dioxide-rich world.

translation.passage_zh: 盖尔·琼斯的小说虽得到大量评论关注，她同样低调却颇具力量的诗歌作品整体却几乎被学者忽视。值得注意的是，琼斯首次发表作品就是诗歌；从 1969 年至 20 世纪 80 年代初，她创作的诗歌几乎与短篇小说一样多，显示出她对诗歌持续而基础性的投入。她作为诗人未获评论界认可，至少部分源于她对体裁边界和艺术身份有据可查的矛盾态度：“我从未真正把自己当作诗人。我写所谓诗歌，但我一直认为自己主要是小说家，所以我是从讲故事者的视角与兴趣来写诗。”与这一自我定位相符，琼斯评论其他诗人作品时，常聚焦传统上与小说写作相关的技巧：叙事及其呈现通常比格律和形式等诗歌惯例更重要。评论斯特林·布朗的作品时，琼斯列出一张清单，记录她在诗歌中最受吸引的特征：人物塑造和叙述声音居于前景，并配合戏剧形式、场景等小说的结构关切；这些共同显示出她主要关心建构有效讲故事的诗学。

options_zh.label: E
options_zh.text_zh: 琼斯在诗歌中最感兴趣的特质。

translation.passage_zh: 一些科学家推测，大气二氧化碳浓度预计会升高，这可能提高作物产量，从而在世界人口增长时帮助满足食品需求。大多数植物分为 C3 或 C4 型，分别指不同的光合作用途径。超过 90% 的植物属于 C3 型；C3 植物从二氧化碳增加中获益远多于 C4 植物。实验表明，二氧化碳浓度加倍可使 C3 植物生长率、因而 C3 作物产量提高 20% 至 35%；而 C4 植物获益很小，C4 植物包括玉米、甘蔗等重要粮食作物，以及许多供牲畜取食的牧草。关于作物对二氧化碳反应的大部分信息来自未考虑杂草造成减产竞争的实验。预测未来富二氧化碳世界中的作物产量时，还必须考虑各地杂草和作物物种组合、作物对降水和温度等环境条件的反应，以及因二氧化碳相关气候变化而可能发生的昆虫、真菌和细菌性作物害虫地理分布变化。

options_zh.label: E

passage.text: Although vastly popular during its time, much nineteenth-century women's fiction in the United States went unread by the twentieth-century educated elite, who were taught to ignore it as didactic. However, American literature has a tradition of didacticism going back to its Puritan roots, shifting over time from sermons and poetic transcripts into novels, which proved to be perfect vehicles for conveying social values. passage.text: To assess the impact of severe drought and drought- related fire on rain-forest vegetation, Leighton and Wirawan studied eastern Borneo following the 1982-1983 drought (when rainfall was nearly 70 percent below normal) by comparing postdrought data from various rain-forest plots with 1977-1979 data from the same plots. Some of the plots had been burned; others were only affected by drought. The large, normally evergreen canopy trees had begun shedding their leaves in February 1983 and were leafless when fires began in April 1983. The study revealed that canopy trees suffered more from drought than from fire: there was no difference in mortality between burned and unburned plots. Drought impact was greatest (37 to 71 percent of canopy trees killed) on steep slopes and ridges due to the limited water reserves of the shallow soil in such sites, while drought damage was least (11 percent of canopy trees killed) in a valley-bottom plot, which had deeper soil. Small trees and vines were largely unaffected by drought but were more easily killed by fire than were canopy trees. Thus, areas affected by drought alone witnessed a decline in larger trees' importance, whereas areas affected by drought and fire saw an increase in their relative importance because of their greater survival rate.

answer.rationale_zh: 文章比较受火和未受火样地，进而分别讨论干旱与火对不同植物的影响；其核心是评估二者对雨林植物的相对影响。

translation.passage_zh: 为评估严重干旱及与干旱相关的火灾对雨林植被的影响，莱顿和维拉万在 1982—1983 年干旱后研究了婆罗洲东部；当时降雨量比正常水平低近 70%。他们将多个雨林样地的干旱后数据与同一批样地 1977—1979 年的数据进行比较。有些样地遭遇过火灾，另一些仅受干旱影响。通常常绿的大型冠层树在 1983 年 2 月开始落叶，到 4 月火灾开始时已经无叶。研究显示，冠层树受干旱的损害大于受火灾的损害：发生火灾和未发生火灾样地的死亡率没有差异。由于浅层土壤蓄水有限，陡坡和山脊上的干旱影响最大（37% 至 71% 的冠层树死亡）；而在土层较深的谷底样地，干旱损害最小（仅 11% 的冠层树死亡）。小树和藤本植物基本不受干旱影响，却比冠层树更容易被火烧死。因此，只受干旱影响地区中，大树的重要性下降；同时受干旱和火灾影响地区中，大树因存活率较高而在相对意义上更为重要。

passage.text: A longstanding scholarly neglect of the subject of cooking is partly attributable to the antiquated "separate spheres" schema that differentiated a private female sphere, which included food preparation and consumption, from a public male sphere, which included food production. While this concept never reflected most women's daily realities—women are major food producers worldwide—the ideological polarization certainly influenced the development of academia: it effectively segregated women into working in low-status "domestic" disciplines such as dietetics and home economics, while the male-dominated realms of industrial agriculture, food technology, mass retailing, and corporate management enjoyed public respect and academic prestige. This institutionalized bias delayed serious attention to cooking even after feminists in the 1960s obliterated the notion of separate spheres and more women entered all areas of academia.

translation.passage_zh: 学界长期忽视烹饪这一主题，部分可归因于一种陈旧的“分离领域”框架：它把包括食物准备和消费在内的女性私人领域，与包括食物生产在内的男性公共领域区分开来。虽然这个概念从未反映大多数女性的日常现实——女性在世界各地都是重要食物生产者——这种意识形态上的两极化确实影响了学术的发展：它实际上把女性隔离在营养学、家政学等低地位的“家庭”学科中，而由男性主导的工业农业、食品技术、大众零售和企业管理领域则享有公共尊重和学术声望。即便 20 世纪 60 年代的女权主义者已摧毁“分离领域”观念，且更多女性进入学术界所有领域，这种制度化偏见仍推迟了对烹饪的严肃关注。
